snippet.title: Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman - Monster Fusion Trailer!
snippet.description:
Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman is a 2D/3D collectathon platformer!  You can catch monsters, level them up, and fuse them together to create new, custom monsters!

Cutscenes are fully voice-acted and animated, and the game will be coming to all major console platforms (switch, playstation, PC, and xbox!)
